problem.problem:
Charlie is young. Fiona is blue. Gary is blue. Gary is white. Harry is blue. Harry is round. Harry is smart. If Charlie is round and Charlie is quiet then Charlie is not young. If something is quiet then it is smart. All blue things are young. Big, blue things are quiet. Young, white things are round. If Fiona is big and Fiona is not white then Fiona is blue. If Charlie is big and Charlie is young then Charlie is not smart. Round things are big.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Charlie is not big.

Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Smart($x, bool) ::: Is x smart?
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?

Facts:
Young(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is young.
Blue(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is blue.
Blue(Gary, True) ::: Gary is blue.
White(Gary, True) ::: Gary is white.
Blue(Harry, True) ::: Harry is blue.
Round(Harry, True) ::: Harry is round.
Smart(Harry, True) ::: Harry is smart.

Rules:
Round(Charlie, True) && Quiet(Charlie, True) >>> Young(Charlie, False) ::: If Charlie is round and Charlie is quiet then Charlie is not young.
Quiet($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: If something is quiet then it is smart.
Blue($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: All blue things are young.
Big($x, True) && Blue($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: Big, blue things are quiet.
Young($x, True) && White($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: Young, white things are round.
Big(Fiona, True) && White(Fiona, False) >>> Blue(Fiona, True) ::: If Fiona is big and Fiona is not white then Fiona is blue.
Big(Charlie, True) && Young(Charlie, True) >>> Smart(Charlie, False) ::: If Charlie is big and Charlie is young then Charlie is not smart.
Round($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: Round things are big.

Query:
Big(Charlie, False) ::: Charlie is not big.
